description: This file defines the LocationEmployeeCount class, a Data Transfer Object (DTO) used within the OrangeHRM dashboard plugin to represent the count of employees per location, including location ID and name.

classes.name: LocationEmployeeCount
classes.description: A DTO class encapsulating location ID, location name, and employee count for use within OrangeHRM dashboard plugin.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializes the LocationEmployeeCount object with location ID, name, and employee count.

methods.name: getLocationId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the location.

methods.name: getLocationName
methods.description: Returns the name of the location.

methods.name: getEmployeeCount
methods.description: Returns the number of employees at the location.
